# Taste Skill

Source: https://github.com/Leonxlnx/taste-skill

Apply this as a design-quality layer for Manager 90. The source emphasizes brief inference, explicit design direction, deliberate visual variance/motion/density, audit-first redesigns, anti-default discipline, and a pre-flight self-critique.

## Manager 90 adaptation
- Never default to generic SaaS cards, purple gradients, glassmorphism everywhere, or interchangeable dashboard templates.
- Preserve the RЕСО brand while creating a distinctive product language.
- Treat redesign as a system-level exercise, not isolated CSS polishing.
- Before implementation, identify audience, product context, brand assets, density, motion and visual hierarchy.
- Self-review alignment, hierarchy, whitespace, states, responsiveness and perceived quality before calling a screen finished.
